0022600123.text: The Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East, third in the Central and one game back) visit the Bucks (0-3, 14th in the East, fifth in the Central and 2.5 games back), who have lost three straight. The teams have not met yet this season, and Indiana went 0-4 against Milwaukee in 2025-26, including a 134-123 loss in Milwaukee on March 15. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Ivica Zubac is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision.
